verses.1: For destruction, wisdom is given to David.
verses.2: When David arrived at the house of Achimelic, he told Saul that David was coming to his house.
verses.3: What will the wicked ruler do? May he be blessed every day.
verses.4: Be considerate of others as if they were your own family members, and act with kindness and respect.
verses.5: You loved evil over good, falsehood over truth, and deceit over righteousness.
verses.6: You loved all those false words.
verses.7: May he also take you away forever; may he tear you away from your tent and from your dwelling place in the land of life.
verses.8: And they shall see the righteous, and they shall fear them. And they shall sing praises to Him.
verses.9: See, the Lord will not abandon His people in their time of need. He will surely help them with His power.
verses.10: And I am like a lamp in the house of God. I trust in God’s grace forever and ever.
verses.11: You are worthy of eternal glory, for you have done so. I will praise your name, for it is good in the eyes of your saints.
